name: Skerries Loop
description: North Dublin coastal loop out to Skerries and back. Flat and fast with sea views.

name: Skerries via the Lanes
description: The long way to Skerries through the country lanes. Rolling north Dublin roads with a coastal finish.

name: Dublin Canal Ride
description: Flat loop following the canals west to Celbridge and back. Perfect Sunday spin or interval-friendly for threshold work on the towpath straights.

name: Dublin to Athlone Canal Route
description: Dublin to Athlone and back on the canal towpaths and roads. A proper full-day adventure.

name: Wicklow 200
description: 200km through the Wicklow Mountains via Gorey. 3,400m of climbing. The sportive route that defines Irish road cycling.
